title: Scandal Pearl
lines: The Scandal Pearl is Hammer’s strongest pearlized ball to date. Our carbon fiber technology has knocked another one out of the park.
This 500/1000 Abralon ™ Powerhouse Factory Finish Polish finish on the Semtex Pearl CFI coverstock gives this angular monster the ability to handle medium to heavy oil patterns.
Hammer’s strongest symmetrical core, the Scandal core, is back and this time it is wrapped with Hammers Semtex Pearl CFI cover.
FACTORY FINISH 500/1000 Abralon® Polished w/ Powerhouse™ Factory Finish Polish
BEST LANE CONDITION Medium to Heavy Oil
